data.raw_text:
A traffic advisory has been issued in view of the ongoing construction of the flyover at Cycle Factory Junction and its extension up to Lalgnesh Market on the Guwahati–Garbhanga Road.

To ensure public safety and facilitate construction work, vehicular movement will be restricted during night hours from 11:00 PM to 5:00 AM until completion of the project.

During the restricted hours, traffic from Cycle Factory Tiniali to Barsapara Tiniali will not be allowed. Vehicles coming from the Arya Nagar/Birubari side will be diverted via FA Road towards Mora Bharalu Road, Ambari Tiniali and A.K. Dev Road, while those from the Lalgnesh side will be diverted from Barsapara Tiniali via Kula Basumatary Road (ACA Stadium Road) towards Mora Bharalu Road, Dr Bhupen Hazarika Road, Dhirenpara Tiniali and A.K. Dev Road.

The advisory also states that in case of emergencies, movement of ambulances and fire tenders will be facilitated by PWRD. The decision was taken at a special DRSC meeting held on February 6, 2026, chaired by the Chairman, DRSC and the District Commissioner, Kamrup Metropolitan. Authorities have urged commuters to cooperate and follow the diversions in the interest of public safety.

#guwahati #TheAssamTribune

@GhtyTrafficPol
